integrity: The exact hyperbolic formulas follow from three killed-boundary resolvents and renewal differentiation. Strict numerical inequalities are proved by exact-rational Taylor interval bounds, with an independent discretized generator comparison. Literature priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Reflected one-dimensional interval; independent Poisson position resetting to the initial location; visits persist; exact second moment and one strict mean–variance comparison. The midpoint is not asserted globally variance-optimal. No finite-sample estimation or general resetting kernel is treated.
title: Exact cover-time variance and a mean–risk conflict in Brownian resetting
